copy.headline: You're probably refrigerating half these foods.
items: Refrigerating them is making them worse.
And you've been doing it your whole life.

copy.headline: The rule: Cold air preserves food vulnerable to bacteria and moisture loss.
copy.body: But cold also breaks down starches in vegetables, stops ripening mid-track, and turns fats grainy. Not every food benefits. The question is always: is this food vulnerable, or is it alive?

copy.headline: Tomatoes: Cold destroys the enzymes that create flavor.
items: A refrigerated tomato tastes like a tomato-shaped nothing.
Counter: 3-5 days ripe, full flavor. Fridge: 2 weeks, no flavor.
Counter until ripe, then fridge for 1-2 days max - any longer and the flesh browns and goes mushy.

copy.headline: Bananas: Fridge cold turns the skin black within hours.
items: The fruit is fine, but it looks rotten - and confusion follows.
Counter until your preferred ripeness, then freeze (not refrigerate) to pause.
Onions & Garlic: Cold and humidity make them sprout and go mushy.
They need airflow and dry conditions - a counter bowl or mesh bag.
Exception: cut onion -> fridge, airtight container only.

copy.headline: Potatoes: Cold converts starch to sugar, giving them an unnaturally sweet taste and causing them to darken when cooked.
items: Store in a cool, dark, dry place - pantry, never fridge.
Never store with onions; they accelerate each other's spoilage.
Bread: Refrigeration stales bread 3x faster through starch retrogradation.
Counter for up to 4 days. Freeze beyond that - never refrigerate.

quadrants.label: Counter
quadrants.value: Tomatoes · Avocados (until ripe) · Bananas · Onions · Garlic · Potatoes · Bread · Honey · Citrus

quadrants.label: Fridge
quadrants.value: Anything cut · Anything cooked · Raw meat · Dairy · Berries · Leafy greens · Herbs (in water) · Opened condiments

quadrants.label: Never
quadrants.value: Honey (solidifies) · Whole coffee beans (absorbs fridge odors) · Uncut tomatoes

copy.headline: Your fridge isn't too full. Half of what's in it doesn't belong there.
